name: session-desktop-health-after-boot
context:
From the desktop please do the following:

- `omarchy-version` prints the version of the build under test; any version number passes.
steps: Look at the desktop. The bar is up. No crash dialog is showing.
Run `omarchy-shell shell ping` and press Enter. It prints `ok`.
Run `omarchy-version` and press Enter. A version prints.
Run `findmnt -no FSTYPE /` and press Enter. It prints `btrfs`.
Run `wpctl status | head -3` and press Enter. A PipeWire header prints.
Run `systemctl --failed --no-legend --plain; systemctl --user --failed --no-legend --plain; echo UNITS-DONE` and press Enter. Nothing is listed above `UNITS-DONE`.
proof:
* On success
** The final screen shows the bar and wallpaper with no crash dialog, and the terminal reading `ok`, the version, `btrfs`, the PipeWire header, and `UNITS-DONE` with nothing listed above it
* If unsuccessful
** The failing command on screen (a missing bar, `omarchy-shell is not running`, `connection refused`, or a listed unit)
